title: Rie Aruga's Sheltering Eaves Manga Ends With 8th Volume
content: The seventh compiled book volume of Rie Aruga 's Sheltering Eaves ( Koboreru Yoru ni ) manga revealed on July 13 that the manga will end with its eighth volume. title: GKIDS Streams Trailer for your name. 10th Anniversary Screening on August 14
content: GKIDS started streaming on Wednesday the trailer for the 10th Anniversary 4K remaster screening of Makoto Shinkai 's your name. film in North America on August 14. GKIDS describes the film: One morning, rural schoolgirl Mitsuha and city kid Taki awaken to discover that they've switched bodies.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Eri Short Anime Reveals Preview, Synopsis, and Staff
content: My Hero Academia revealed the preview for the upcoming new short anime covering a special Eri chapter from My Hero Academia: Ultra Age . The chapter shows on Eri in high school, and its anime adaptation will premiere on August 2. It will stream on Crunchyroll.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime Reveals 3 New Cast Members
content: The staff for Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga, revealed three new cast members and characters on Thursday. The characters will appear in the anime's sixth episode on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Additional Cast for 'Tenmaku no Jaadugar' Announced
content: The official website of the Tenmaku no Jaadugar ( Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia ) television anime announced additional cast ahead of episode 6 on Thursday. The anime series adapting Tomato Soup 's historical drama manga premiered with a 60-minute special on July 4 at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Exstetra RPG's HD Remaster Launches on Switch, Switch 2, PS5 on September 3
content: FuRyu announced on Thursday that the HD remaster for its Exstetra fantasy role-playing game will launch on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 5 on September 3. The game launched on PC via Steam on Thursday, July 30. The Steam page describes the game: A fantasy RPG where a kiss saves the world.
author: ANN

title: Bungo Stray Dogs: Tales of the Lost Game Ends Service on Friday
content: The game launched in Japan in 2017. Ambition released the game in English in July 2018. Crunchyroll began serving as the new publisher of the game in November 2018, but ceased to do so as of November 2020, after which Ambition took over the management of the English version again.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens at #1, 5th Live-Action Kingdom Film Drops to #3
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, opened on Friday and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 'Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun' BL Series' Trailer Unveils More Cast, Opening Song

title: Sins of Kujo Manga Gets Live-Action Film in 2027
content: TOHO Films announced in a teaser video on Thursday that Shohei Manabe 's Kujō no Taizai (Sins of Kujo) manga is inspiring a live-action film on January 8, 2027. The staff and other cast members from the live-action series are also returning for the film.
author: ANN
